text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. As artificial intelligence becomes part of our daily lives, we must think about how it affects people. One key problem is bias. If the data used to train AI is not balanced, the system can treat some groups unfairly. Fairness means AI should make decisions that are just for everyone. Privacy is also a serious concern, because AI often collects and uses personal information. Companies must protect this data. Transparency matters too: people should understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means building systems that are safe and benefit society. Governments, companies, and users all share this responsibility.
